verses.text: One day Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he finished, one of his followers said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his followers."
He said to them, "When you pray, say, 'Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
Give us each day our daily bread.
Forgive us our sins, because we also forgive everyone who owes us. And do not lead us into testing, but save us from the evil one.'"
Then he said to them, "Suppose one of you has a friend, and you go to him at midnight and say, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread.
A friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to give him.'
And suppose he answers from inside, 'Do not bother me. The door is already shut, and my children are with me in bed. I cannot get up and give you anything.'
I tell you, even if he will not get up and give you the bread because he is your friend, he will get up because you keep asking, and he will give you as much as you need.
So I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given to you. Keep looking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and the door will be opened to you.
Everyone who asks receives. The one who looks finds. And the door will be opened to the one who knocks.
Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
If you, then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?"
Jesus was driving out a demon that could not speak. When the demon had gone out, the man who had been unable to speak began to speak, and the crowds were amazed.
But some of them said, "He drives out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of demons."
Others tested him by asking for a sign from heaven.
Jesus knew their thoughts and said, "Every kingdom that fights against itself is ruined, and a house that is divided against itself falls.
If Satan also fights against himself, how can his kingdom stand? You say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
But if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your followers drive them out? So they will be your judges.
But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come to you.
When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his things are safe.
But when someone stronger attacks him and wins, he takes away the armour the man trusted in, and he divides up what he stole.
Whoever is not with me is against me. And whoever does not gather with me scatters.
When an evil spirit comes out of a person, it goes through dry places looking for rest, and it does not find any. Then it says, 'I will go back to the house I left.'
When it returns, it finds the house swept and tidy.
Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they go in and live there. So that person's last state is worse than the first."
As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd called out, "Blessed is the womb that carried you, and the breasts that nursed you!"
But he said, "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it."
As the crowds grew larger, Jesus said, "The people of today are evil. They ask for a sign, but none will be given to them except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, so the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.

The Queen of the South will rise up at the judgement with the people of today and condemn them. She came from the ends of the earth to hear Solomon's wisdom, and look, someone greater than Solomon is here.
The people of Nineveh will stand up at the judgement with this generation and condemn it, because they turned from their sins when Jonah preached. And look, someone greater than Jonah is here.
No one lights a lamp and puts it in a cellar or under a basket. They put it on a stand, so that people who come in can see the light.
Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eye is healthy, your whole body is full of light. But when it is bad, your body is full of darkness.
So make sure that the light in you is not darkness.
If your whole body is full of light, with no dark part, it will be completely bright, as when a lamp shines on you with its light."
When Jesus had finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him to eat with him. So he went in and sat down at the table.
The Pharisee was surprised that Jesus did not wash before the meal.
The Lord said to him, "You Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and the plate, but inside you are full of greed and evil.
You foolish people! Did not the one who made the outside also make the inside?
So give what is inside to the poor, and then everything will be clean for you.

But how terrible for you Pharisees! You give a tenth of your mint, rue, and every herb, but you neglect justice and the love of God. You should have done these things, without leaving the others undone.
How terrible for you Pharisees! You love the best seats in the synagogues and to be greeted in the market places.
How terrible for you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like unmarked graves that people walk over without knowing it."
One of the experts in the law answered, "Teacher, when you say these things you insult us too."
Jesus said, "How terrible for you experts in the law as well! You load people with burdens that are hard to carry, and you yourselves will not lift even one finger to help them.
How terrible for you! You build tombs for the prophets, and it was your fathers who killed them.
So you show that you agree with what your fathers did. They killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
Because of this, the wisdom of God said, 'I will send them prophets and apostles. They will kill some of them and hunt down others,
so that the people of today will be held responsible for the blood of all the prophets shed since the world was made,
from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who was killed between the altar and the holy place.' Yes, I tell you, the people of today will be held responsible.
How terrible for you experts in the law! You have taken away the key of knowledge. You did not go in yourselves, and you stopped those who were trying to go in."
When Jesus left there, the teachers of the law and the Pharisees began to oppose him fiercely and to question him about many things.
They were waiting to trap him in something he might say, so that they could accuse him.
